description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
When Urza's Bauble enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Urza's Bauble.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Urza's Bauble ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
